name: RebirthAwaken
_intent: A villain levels up: down on one knee with the head bowed and the right fist's knuckles on the ground, the left forearm across the front knee (0-1.2 s); slowly rises as the fists clench, the rear foot steps through, the body trembling harder with power, head still down (1.2-3.4 s); explodes upward onto the balls of the feet, head thrown back, arms flung wide and up, chest out (Burst 3.5 s); settles into a confident power stance, feet apart, fists at hip level slightly out, chin raised, held.
_reference: superhero landing kneel -> trembling rise -> power-up burst -> power stance; 6.0 s

keyframes._note: one knee down, head bowed, right fist on the ground
rear knee off, the foot steps through
rear foot plants: trembling with power
BURST: head thrown back, arms flung wide and up
